summary: The construction and proof are correct for every integer m >= 1. The support is complete with affine rank 2 and difference lattice Z^2, and the stated globally log-affine law has partition function 4 and equal row masses. The interval capacity bounds, exposed-face decoupling, cubic row-mass factors, and rational arithmetic establish 16 B_2(p) <= 505/256 < 2 using exactly the accepted normalization. The two original score values each have mass 1/2, so the minimum 3/4-mass interval width is log(2m), and the original self-varentropy is (log(2m))^2/4. Boundary targets and the smallest case m = 1 introduce no gaps.
